_notes: 2024 PHB 'Multiclassing > Prerequisites': 13+ in the PRIMARY ability of the new class AND of every class you already have. all_of = every listed ability needs 13+; any_of = at least one does (Fighter: Strength or Dexterity). Derived from each class's 'Primary Ability' row; Artificer is Intelligence (Eberron: Forge of the Artificer).
